name: rbe-filter
info:
Report By Exception (RBE) filtering subflow.

Suppresses redundant telemetry when sensor values haven't changed significantly.
Compares each value against last-sent value using configurable deadband thresholds.

Input:
- msg.payload: {"ts": <epoch_ms>, "values": {key: val, ...}} (ThingsBoard normalized format)
- msg.anomaly (optional): if true, bypasses filter entirely
- msg.critical (optional): if true, bypasses filter entirely

Output:
- msg.payload with only changed keys (values exceeding deadband), or null if all suppressed

Configuration:
- flow context 'rbeThresholds': {telemetry_key: deadband_value} (set by config inject node)
- Default deadband: 0 (pass everything for unconfigured keys)

Filtered count:
- Increments flow context 'rbeFilteredCount' for each suppressed key
- Read by stats publisher node on protocol-normalization flow

name: rbe-evaluate
